claim_scope: Reliability of the frozen Observation-Constraint-Operation failure taxonomy on A-only Dev bad cases; no treatment-effect claim.

annotation_population.definition: Every case whose frozen-A terminal outcome is official_fail, agent_noncompletion, or qualification_fail.

independent_replication_sample.selection_time: after the complete bad-case identity list is frozen and before the second annotator opens any selected trajectory
independent_replication_sample.sample_size: min(N, max(30, ceil(0.25 * N))), where N is the complete bad-case count
selection_inputs: membership in the complete A-only bad-case list

second_annotator_hidden_inputs: all B or C trajectories and outcomes
whether any proposed algorithm repairs the case
blinding.allowed_inputs: The same frozen-A artifacts and frozen taxonomy available to the primary annotator.
blinding.annotator_identity_freeze: Record annotator identity and annotation-assistance mode before opening selected labels.

annotation_assistance.evidence_packet_generation: Automated tools or language models may retrieve and index A-only evidence.
annotation_assistance.final_labels: Primary and independent labels used for the paper reliability claim must be entered by named researchers; model suggestions are supplementary and cannot replace independent final coding.
annotation_assistance.adjudication: A named researcher adjudicates disagreements after both original annotations are frozen.

primary_subtype: hierarchical agreement conditional on primary-layer agreement
reliability_metrics.threshold_policy: Report all metrics without dropping labels or changing the taxonomy to cross an agreement threshold.

adjudication_policy.new_mechanism: Use unresolved/novel-mechanism-held-for-taxonomy-v2; do not add a v1 label.
